svg.desc: Wide vector wallpaper inspired by 2000s Frutiger Metro. On the right, a beautiful adult woman in a clear side profile silhouette, shoulder and head with long hair flowing into ornamental curls; the woman is a single solid dark indigo shape with a recognizable nose, lips and chin. Surround the silhouette with bold stylized flowers, spirals, stars and dots. Flat solid color palette: violet, indigo, pink, coral and soft lavender. Smooth shapes and clean curves, no texture or shading. Keep the left two-thirds simple lavender negative space for software content. Full bleed, no words, logos, borders, panels or interface.
